name: open_downloads_in_dolphin
goal: Open the KDE file manager and navigate to ~/Downloads. Delete nothing, confirm nothing, approve nothing.
_comment_policy: Desktop automation is where deny_labels earns its keep: a confirmation dialog can appear anywhere, so refusing clicks on anything *called* Delete/Confirm/Empty Trash is more reliable than fencing off screen regions.

launch.brief: Open the application launcher and start the file manager.
launch.hint: The launcher is already opening. Type into it; do not click first.

type_name.brief: Type 'dolphin' and press Enter to launch the file manager.
type_name.hint: The search field already has focus.

navigate.brief: Press ctrl+l, type the Downloads path, press Enter.
navigate.hint: ctrl+l has already been pressed and the location bar has focus. Just type the path.

notes: Written for KDE Plasma. On GNOME change launch.on_enter to k:meta and the labels to match the Activities overview; on XFCE use k:meta or the applications menu. Run with dry_run first and read voltage_journal - if the vision model never reports 'search field', try 'text input' or 'search box' instead.
